sections.name: mission
sections.value: FRESH cross-model review of s122 at pinned 2701005f. READ-ONLY. Context: the FIRST reviewer produced seven findings (R001-R007) and the coder has since REBUILT the mechanism as one PaneTransaction rather than patching. You are reviewing the REBUILD, not the original. That first reviewer then degraded — it re-derived the same finding repeatedly and issued an APPROVE that was silent on its own open findings. So: form your OWN view from source, cite it, and if you find yourself repeating a finding you already sent, stop and say so.

sections.name: instructions
value: Read plan.dd.md, impl-guide.dd.md, assets/reviews/review.047ea0ed.md (the R001-R007 set), assets/reviews/review-fixes.md (the coder's response), then the diff at 2701005f

PRIORITY 1 — is the ownership invariant actually indivisible now? One PaneTransaction should own token, marker, input state and exemption. Hunt for any path where marker/input/exemption can still diverge, and for any state transition NOT conditioned on the 128-bit token

PRIORITY 2 — the exit table (success/stage-fail/commit-fail/cleanup-fail/abort/deadline/death/drop-without-commit): verify each row is ASSERTED BY A TEST, not merely documented. The invariant to check on every row: input ends ENABLED on every ownership-mismatch or error path
PRIORITY 3 — Enter as irreversible success: prove a forced cleanup error after Enter yields exactly ONE delivery and does not report failure
PRIORITY 4 — concurrency witnesses: two adapters in one process and two processes racing one pane. Confirm they would FAIL against the pre-rebuild code (a green-from-birth test is not a witness)

PRIORITY 5 — R004 negative parser test (decoration must NOT read as an idle composer) and R005/R006 keep_control_body_pullable with forced lookup and clock errors: confirm the refused body stays readable
Check the stated supported body-size ceiling has a bound test at the LARGEST supported size, and that behaviour above it is defined
Report to the PRIME (pij-still-weasel). Verdict: APPROVE or findings with severity. State which claims you verified yourself vs took on the coder's evidence.
